technology_name: Bamboo Innovation Hub: Art, Ecology, and Enterprise (Bamboo Crafts)
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: Unemployment among rural youth/women, the marginalization of traditional artisanal skills, and the underutilization of highly renewable local bamboo resources.
description: A Bamboo Craft Centre operating as a Common Facility Centre under the National Bamboo Mission. It provides hands-on skill development for rural communities to manufacture eco-friendly, value-added bamboo products (souvenirs, home decor). The initiative is vertically integrated, utilizing sustainably harvested poles from JNTBGRI's 20-acre Bamboo Conservatory (housing 1,200+ accessions) while offering downstream marketing, branding, and retail support.
applications:
• Sustainable FMCG lifestyle products and home decor manufacturing

• Rural micro-enterprise and artisan cooperative society development

• Eco-tourism souvenirs and premium corporate gifting

• Commercial sustainable raw material supply chain management
contact_person: Dr. Jothish P S & Dr. B Gopakumar
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
